children: GeoVax Labs said board member Tyler O'Brien has been named as its new chairman, and will also assume the role of interim chief executive.

He succeeds David Dodd, who was president, chairman and CEO. GeoVax said Dodd was terminated for cause on Nov. 5. The biotechnology company also said whether "cause" existed under the employment agreement hasn't been determined by a court or arbitrator.
The termination was unrelated to the company's business operations, financial results, or previously filed financial statements, GeoVax added.
Dodd joined the company's board of directors in 2010 and was elected chairman in 2011. He was president and CEO since 2018.
O'Brien is co-founder and managing partner of commercial real estate investment firm Top Tier, which is located in South Florida.
GeoVax also said Shahin Behroyan was named as a director of the company.
